claim.claim-text: 1. A surveillance unit, comprising: a first battery and a second battery; a number of electronic devices; and circuitry including: power reset logic configured to, in response to a first event, reset at least one electronic device of the number of electronic devices; a power path controller coupled to the power reset logic and configured to, in response to a second event, switch power to one or more of the number of electronic devices from the first battery to the second battery; and a charge controller coupled to the power path controller and configured to supply a current to the second battery at one of a number of selectable levels.
2. The surveillance unit of claim 1, further comprising at least one renewable energy source coupled to the at least one of the first battery or the second battery.

3. The surveillance unit of claim 1, the circuitry further comprising a number of measurement devices, at least some of the number of electronic devices coupled to a measurement device of the number of measurement devices.
4. The surveillance unit of claim 3, wherein each measurement device is configured to report at least one measurement associated with a corresponding electronic device.
5. The surveillance unit of claim 4, wherein the at least one measurement comprises a voltage measurement, a current measurement, or both.

6. The surveillance unit of claim 1, further comprising: a head unit including or coupled to at least some of the electronic devices and housing the circuitry; a mast having one end attached to the head unit; and a trailer attached to a second, opposite end of the mast.
7. The surveillance unit of claim 1, wherein the power reset logic resets the at least one electronic device responsive to receipt of a control signal from either a modem or a processor.
8. The surveillance unit of claim 1, further comprising a solar power system coupled to at least one of the first battery or the second battery.

10. The surveillance unit of claim 9, the circuitry further comprising a charge controller to enable at least one of the first power source or the second power source to be charged via one of two selectable current levels.

11. The surveillance unit of claim 10, wherein the charge controller is configured to receive a current at a first level and convey current at a second, different level to one of the first power source or the second power source.
12. The surveillance unit of claim 9, the number of loads including at least one sensor.
13. The surveillance unit of claim 9, the circuitry further comprising: a power input connector; and a reverse polarity protection circuit coupled between the power input connector and the circuit.
14. The surveillance unit of claim 9, further comprising the first power source and the second power source, one of the first power source or the second power source comprising a backup battery.

15. The surveillance unit of claim 9, wherein each measurement device of the number of measurement devices is configured to sense at least one of a voltage or a current associated with a corresponding load of the number of loads.
16. The surveillance unit of claim 9, further comprising at least one of a modem or a processor configured to convey a signal to the power reset logic to reset the at least one load.

17. A surveillance unit, comprising: a number of loads; a first battery and a second battery; and a control circuit including: an input connector for coupling to the first battery; a power path controller coupled to the input connector and configured to switch power to at least some of the number of loads from a first battery to the second battery or vice versa; and power reset logic coupled to the power path controller and configured to reset at least one load of the number of loads responsive to an event.
18. The surveillance unit of claim 17, the control circuit further including a charge controller configured to limit an amount of current conveyed to the second battery.

19. The surveillance unit of claim 17, the control circuit further comprising a measurement device configured for measuring at least one parameter associated with a corresponding load of the number of loads.
20. The surveillance unit of claim 19, wherein the at least one parameter comprises at least one of a voltage measurement or a current measurement.
